anomalies.description: A person in a black shirt is kneeling over a prone individual on the floor and forcibly inserting a metal tool (appears to be a wrench or socket extension) into the victim's mouth, while holding the victim's head and hands down. The victim appears helpless and restrained.

A man is lying on the ground, restrained and being forcibly submerged in a liquid (appears to be oil or thick fluid) by another person using a metal tool (possibly a wrench or pipe), while a third man observes. The victim's face is covered in the fluid, and he shows signs of distress and suffocation. This constitutes abuse of a helpless victim.

A person is being forcibly restrained and subjected to a violent act involving a metallic hook-like object inserted into their mouth/face area while lying on the ground; the victim appears helpless and unable to resist.

Two men are engaged in a physical confrontation; one man (foreground) shows signs of exertion and pain, while the other (background) observes closely, suggesting an ongoing or just-concluded struggle. The sequence shows escalating tension and physical strain consistent with hand-to-hand combat.

A man in a light shirt is on the ground, initially bent over and then lying prone, while two other men stand over him in a threatening posture; one appears to have just struck or pushed him down, consistent with abuse of a helpless victim.

Between frames f4 and f7, the man in the black shirt (Vin Diesel) is seen moving aggressively toward the man on the ground, with physical contact implied as the latter falls and ends up on his back—suggesting a brief mutual or one-sided physical confrontation preceding the abusive aftermath.
